```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(ggtext)
```

# Load data

```{r}
load("../data/figure-data/tvol_m10.rda")
load("../data/figure-data/tvol_m1819.rda")
load("../data/figure-data/fracresponse_blautia-gavage.rda")
load("../data/figure-data/boxdat_mimic.rda")
load("../data/figure-data/longmods_mimic-heatmap.rda")
```

# Tumor volume over time - mimic10

```{r}
mimic10.means %>%
  mutate(Gavage = if_else(grepl("v1", treatment.group),
                          true = "Pre-BRB",
                          false = "Post-BRB"),
         Treatment = if_else(grepl("Anti", treatment.group),
                             true = "Anti-PD1",
                             false = "IgG"),
         Gavage = fct_relevel(Gavage, c("Pre-BRB"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = days.from.injection, y = mean)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = treatment.group,
                color = Gavage,
                linetype = Treatment), 
            position = position_dodge(width = .5),
            lwd = 1) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = Gavage), 
             position = position_dodge(width = .5)) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lwr, 
                    ymax = upr,
                    color = Gavage),
                width = 1,
                position = position_dodge(width = .5),
                lwd = 1) +
  labs(x = "Days from Tumor Injection", 
       y = expression("Tumor volume ("~mm^3~")"))  +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) 
ggsave("../figures/lineplot_tumorvol_mim10.png")
```
# Tumor Vol over Time - mimic1819

```{r}
mimic1819.means %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = days.from.injection, y = mean)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = treatment.group,
                color = Supplement,
                linetype = Treatment), 
            lwd = 1) + 
  geom_smooth(aes(color = Supplement, lty = Treatment), size = 0) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = Supplement))+
  labs(x = "Days from Tumor Injection", 
       y = expression("Mean Tumor volume ("~mm^3~")"))  +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") 

ggsave("../figures/meantumorvolume_mim1819_lineplot.png", 
       height = 5, width = 7)
```

# Fraction response - probably needs calculations checked

```{r}
mimic.respose%>%
  mutate(gavage = gsub(" ", "", gavage)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=treatment, y=frac.0)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", 
           position="dodge", 
           aes(fill=gavage)) + 
  labs(y="Fraction Tumor Free", x="Treatment Group") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~experiment) + 
  theme_bw(base_size = 18)
ggsave("../figures/Fraction-Tumor-Free.png", height= 7, width= 7)
```

# Boxplot - filtered BEWELL

```{r}
mim.boxdat$bewell.filt %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = treatment, y = tumor.volume, fill = gavage)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(. ~ patient, scales = "free_y") +
  xlab("Treatment") +
  ylab("Tumor Volume") +
  ggtitle("Mimic Bewell Samples Final Tumor Volume") +
  theme_bw()

ggsave("../figures/BEWELL-filtered-boxplot.png", width = 10, height = 8)
```
# Boxplot - anti-PD1 samples

```{r}
mim.boxdat$labelled.patients %>%
  filter(patient != "other") %>%
  filter(treatment == "Anti-PD1") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = patient, y = tumor.volume)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = gavage)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 18) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(x = "Participant Sample",
       y = expression("Tumor volume ("~mm^3~")"),
       fill = "Gavage")

ggsave("../figures/bewell-samples_PD1-only_boxplot.png",
       height = 5, width = 7)
```

# Boxplot - flo data

```{r}
mim.boxflow %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Treatment, y = Percent)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Gavage)) +
  facet_wrap(~Marker) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 18) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   hjust = 1)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")

ggsave("../figures/boxplot_mimic10_flow.png",
       height = 5, width = 5)
```

# Heatmap - longitudinal model interaction terms

```{r}
mimic.longmods %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = `Combined ID`, y = term.adj, fill = estimate, alpha = sig.flag)) +
  geom_tile(color = "black") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  coord_fixed() +
  guides(alpha = "none") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Test Microbe (Sample ID)", y = "")
  

ggsave("../figures/bewell_heatmap_interaction.png",
       height =  6, width = 6)
```
